description: Le 1, Rue Principale (ou maison de Charles) est partagé par Charles et Scott. Il se trouve près du bateau de Zarah, derrière la Clinique.
description_en: 1 Main Ave (also known as Charles House) is the home shared by Charles and Scott. It is located near Zarah's Boat, behind the clinic.

description: Maison de Frank et Erika et de leurs deux chats, Peanut et Butter.
description_en: House where Frank and Erika live with their two cats Peanut and Butter.

description: Le 2, Rue Principale est la maison de Jim et de ses deux enfants, Lily et Theo.
description_en: 2 Main Avenue is the house where Jim lives with his two children: Lily and Theo.

description: L'Allée des jardins est la zone verte entre la ferme à l'ouest et Starlet Town à l'est. Millie et Yuri y habitent.
description_en: Garden Lane is the green area between the farm to the west and Starlet Town to the east. Millie and Yuri's home is located in Garden Lane.

description: La place Alun-Alun est une zone extérieure à l'est du lac. Elle reste fermée sauf pendant certains festivals qui s'y déroulent.
description_en: Alun-Alun Square is an outdoor area east of the lake. It is closed off at all times except for specific festivals that take place in the square.

extra.ferme_le: Tous les jours sauf pendant certains festivals

description: L'Auberge du corail se trouve sur la jetée de la plage.
description_en: Coral Inn is an inn situated on the pier at the beach.

description: La forêt de bambous (ou sanctuaire de bambous) se débloque le lendemain de la dixième offrande au Temple du lac. Riche en pousses de bambou, c'est là que vit Pandazen.
description_en: Bamboo forest, or also known as bamboo sanctuary, is unlocked the following day after completing any ten offerings at the Lake Temple. The area is rich with Bamboo shoot and is where Pandazen lives.

description: Le Band of Smiles est une guilde d'aventuriers active autour de Coral Island. Kira dirige la branche locale et décide des adhésions ; Jio Dan tient la boutique. Le repaire possède un tableau de petits boulots propres à la guilde.
description_en: The Band of Smiles is an adventurers' guild active in the Coral Island area. Kira runs the island's local branch and makes the final decisions on its membership while Jio Dan runs the guild store. The hideout also contains a job board to take on guild-specific Errands.

description: Les Bains publics sont une source chaude tenue par Takeba, temporairement indisponibles en début de partie.
description_en: Bath House is a hot spring run by Takeba. It is temporarily unavailable at the start of the game.

description: Le Bazar de Sam est un lieu de Starlet Town. C'est aussi la maison de Sam et Emily.
description_en: Sam's General Store is a location in Starlet Town. It is also Sam and Emily's house.

description: The Beach is located at the southeast side of Coral Island. It is separated from the Lookout by one of the island's many piers, and is the access point for one of the Diving spots. The Coral Inn is located on the pier, providing guests the ability to listen to the waves crashing on the shore.
description_en: The Beach is located at the southeast side of Coral Island. It is separated from the Lookout by one of the island's many piers, and is the access point for one of the Diving spots. The Coral Inn is located on the pier, providing guests the ability to listen to the waves crashing on the shore.

description: La Bibliothèque est une partie du Centre communautaire où travaille Millie.
description_en: The Library is a section in the Community Center where Millie works.

description: Le Marché noir est une boutique secrète tenue par Ratih les mardi, jeudi et vendredi soir, sur un bateau près du phare. Il propose une sélection aléatoire d'objets rares.
description_en: Black Market is a secret store run by Ratih on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday nights on a boat by the lighthouse. Black Market offers a random selection of rare items.

description: Hillside Brewery and Vineyard, tout à l'est de la ferme, produit uniquement du saké et du vin. Luke, Bree et Walter vivent dans le manoir derrière le vignoble ; Bree supervise la qualité. Ils ne vendent pas directement au public mais fournissent les établissements locaux et exportent l'essentiel de leur production.
description_en: Hillside Brewery and Vineyard is located on the far east of the farm and produces solely sake and wine. It is also where Luke, Bree, and Walter live; their manor is behind the vineyard. Bree oversees the Brewery's quality control. They do not sell their products directly to consumers, but they provide for local establishments and export most of their alcoholic beverages to neighboring countries.

description: Le Cabanon balnéaire est un petit bâtiment de deux étages en bois peint de couleurs vives. Ouvert tous les jours sauf le mardi, il est tenu par les pêcheurs Jim et Sunny. Sunny vit à l'étage avec sa femme Eleanor et son fils Oliver.
description_en: Beach Shack is a two-story small building made with plain carpentry, painted wild and colorful. It is open for shopping every day except Tuesday and run by local fishermen Jim and Sunny. Sunny also lives on the second floor with his family: wife Eleanor and son Oliver.

description: La Caravane est la maison et la boutique de Ben, où il vend des objets au hasard et parfois des trouvailles rares. Ouverte le samedi et le dimanche, elle change de stock et de prix chaque week-end.
description_en: The Caravan is Ben's house and the store he runs where he sells random items and occasionally rare findings. The store is open for business every Saturday and Sunday and works differently from most stores: instead of offering the same items for sale for fixed prices, Ben's stock and prices change every weekend.

description: La Grotte des souvenirs se trouve à l'extrémité nord-ouest de la Savane. Elle devient accessible après avoir terminé toutes les offrandes de l'autel avancé du Temple du lac.
description_en: The Cave of Memories is located at the northwestern corner of the Savannah map. Initially inaccessible, the cave becomes available after completing all the offerings at the Lake Temple's advanced altar.

description: La cave se trouve à droite de la maison de la ferme. Au rang A, sa clé arrive par courrier. On y trouve gratuitement des fûts de vieillissement et un slime de transmutation.
description_en: The cellar is located on the right side of the farmhouse. Once the player reaches town rank A, the key to the cellar can be obtained by mail. The cellar is accessible after. Players can get some free aging barrel and slime of transmutation inside the cellar.

description: Le Centre communautaire, au centre de Starlet Town, regroupe cinq espaces autour d'un hall ouvert où ont lieu les activités de la ville, dont les « réunions » de Theo et Jack.
description_en: The Community Center is a building in the center of Starlet Town that contains 5 key areas located around an open foyer. with open floor plan where town activities are usually held. “Meetings” by Theo and Jack are done in the community center.

description: Le Charpentier est la maison de Joko, Dinda, Archie et Surya, où Joko et Dinda tiennent leur entreprise de construction. On y achète des matériaux, on y construit et améliore les bâtiments de la ferme et on y change l'apparence de la maison.
description_en: The Carpenter is the home of Joko, Dinda, Archie, and Surya, where Joko and Dinda run their construction business. The player has the opportunity to buy building and crafting materials, as well as construct and upgrade farm buildings. The player also has the option to alter the exterior appearance of their house and farm buildings.

description: La boutique de queues de Cho Oyu vend des queues dans le Royaume des ondins. Une seule queue peut être possédée et équipée à la fois.
description_en: Cho Oyu's Tail Shop is a shop selling tails at Merfolk Kingdom. Currently only 1 tail can be owned and equipped at all times.

description: La Clinique vend médicaments et potions. Yuri et Charles y travaillent certains jours.
description_en: Clinic is the place where the player can purchase medicine or potions. Yuri and Charles work here and can be seen inside the clinic on certain days.

description: La Forêt profonde est une zone au nord-ouest de la forêt.
description_en: Deep Forest is an area in the northwestern side of the Forest.

description: Le ponton de plongée se trouve sur la plage, au sud-est de l'Auberge du corail. Son bateau permet de plonger une fois la plongée débloquée. Le ponton est ouvert à toute heure, mais on ne peut commencer une plongée qu'entre 6 h et 23 h.
description_en: The Diving Pier is located in the Beach, southeast of the Coral Inn. The boat at the pier can be used by the player for Diving, once diving is unlocked. While the pier is open at all hours, the player can only start a dive between 6:00 and 23:00.

description: L'École élémentaire Starlet accueille Randy et les enfants pour leurs cours quotidiens, du lundi au vendredi de 9 h à 16 h.
description_en: Starlet Elementary School is the school where Randy and the kids gather around for their daily discussion. The school opens from Monday to Friday, from 9 AM to 4 PM.

description: La Cabane vide, à côté de la mine, abrite une boutique secrète tenue par le Singe inquiet. Une fois une des conditions remplie, le joueur reçoit une lettre et la boutique ouvre.
description_en: The Empty Cabin is located next to the cavern. It is a secret shop ran by Concerned Monkey. Once any requirement below is cleared, the player will receive a letter and then the store would be available.

conditions: requirement: Harvest a meteor or satellite

description: La maison de la ferme est le point de départ du jeu ; elle couvre les besoins de base du joueur.
description_en: The Farmhouse is where the player starts the game. It has several facilities to cover the basic necessities of the player.

description: Les poissons vivent dans les lacs, étangs, la mer et la plupart des points d'eau. On les attrape à la canne à pêche.
description_en: Fish are creatures located in any lake, pond, sea, or most bodies of water on the island. The player can catch fish using a Fishing pole.

description: Fishensips, aussi appelée la Taverne, est un vieux pub irlandais sur les quais de Starlet Town. Il appartient à Betty et est tenu par ses fils Noah et Frank. Betty et Noah vivent à l'étage ; Frank vit avec sa femme Erika à Parkview. Le défunt mari de Betty, Frank Sr., le tenait auparavant.
description_en: Fishensips, or also known as Tavern, is an old Irish pub in Starlet Town docks owned by Betty and run by her sons, Noah and Frank. Betty and Noah live in the upstairs portion of the pub, while Frank lives with his wife, Erika, on Parkview. The tavern was run by Betty's late husband, Frank Sr., prior to his passing.

description: La Forêt couvre une grande partie de l'ouest de la carte, de la Ferme au nord jusqu'à la mine, et vers la Colline et les Bois à l'est. On y trouve le Ranch, la Caravane, la Cabane de la chasseuse et de nombreux singes.
description_en: The Forest makes up much of the western edge of the map, stretching north from the Farm to the Cavern, and to the Hillside and Woodlands in the east. The Ranch, Caravan and Huntress Cabin can all be found here, as well as a thriving monkey population.

description: La Forge des frères Sanchez, tenue par Rafael et Pablo, traite les minerais, améliore les outils et répond aux besoins de combat. On y achète aussi armes et armures.
description_en: Sanchez’ Brothers Blacksmith, owned by Rafael and Pablo, will help the player with processing ores, upgrading tools, and their combat needs. The player can also purchase various weapons and armor here.

description: Le Magasin de meubles de Starlet Town est tenu par des proches de Joko, le charpentier. On y trouve divers styles de meubles, et le choix s'élargit avec le rang de la ville.
description_en: Furniture Store is a shop in Starlet Town run by relatives of Joko the local carpenter. The player can find various styles of furniture in here and more stuff becomes available as they upgrade the town rank.

description: Le Village des géants est une zone à l'ouest de la ferme. D'abord partiellement débloqué au fil de l'histoire, il devient entièrement accessible plus tard. C'est là que vivent les géants et que le joueur peut enchanter ses outils.
description_en: Giant Village is an area west to player's farm. Initially it is partially unlocked by progressing through , and became fully accessible after completing . The village is where the Giants live, and where the player can enchant the tools.

description: La Fresque du gardien est un autel situé entre le Temple du lac et la maison d'Anne.
description_en: The Guardian Mural is an altar located between the Lake Temple and Anne's house.

description: La Colline est une petite région entre la Forêt à l'ouest et les Bois à l'est. Elle comprend Hillside Brewery and Vineyard et l'Observatoire sur la colline derrière.
description_en: Hillside is a small region between the Forest on the west and the Woodlands on the east. It encompasses Hillside Brewery and Vineyard as well as the Observatory on the hill behind it.

description: La Source chaude est une zone de sources naturelles et de bambous tout au nord de la carte, au nord du Vignoble et de l'Observatoire, entre la Forêt et les Bois. Au début, l'essentiel est bloqué par des lianes, mais les abords comptent déjà pour les insectes et la cueillette. On y trouve les Bains publics et parfois un panda.
description_en: The Hot Spring is an area of natural springs and bamboo forest in the northernmost section of the map, positioned north of the Vineyard and Observatory, and between the Forest and Woodlands to its west and east respectively. At the beginning of the game, most of the hot spring area is blocked by vines, but small parts of the region outside of the vines still count as part of it for finding insects and foraging. The Bath House can be found here, as well as the occasional panda.

description: La Cabane de la chasseuse, dans la forêt, abrite Kira (la chasseuse), Jack et leur fils adulte Kenny. Kira surveille la mine ; bien que retraitée, elle veille à ce qu'aucun monstre ne s'en échappe.
description_en: Huntress Cabin is a cabin in the forest. It is the residence of Kira (huntress), Jack, and their adult son, Kenny. Kira and her family live in the forest as Kira spends her days watching The Mine. Although retired, she still makes sure that there are no loose monsters.

description: La ferme est l'endroit où le joueur vit, cultive, élève ses animaux et garde ses animaux de compagnie. Elle se trouve à l'ouest de Starlet Town.
description_en: The farm is where players live and can grow crops and fruit trees, tend farm animals, and keep pets. The player's house and any farm buildings are located on the farm. The farm is west of Starlet Town, both located on Coral Island.

description: La mine se trouve tout au fond de Starlet Town, au nord-ouest de la carte. D'abord inaccessible, elle ouvre le 5e jour.
description_en: The Cavern is located all the way at the back of Starlet Town, at the northwestern corner of the map. Initially inaccessible, the cavern becomes available on Day 5 of the game.

description: Le Labo de Starlet Town est dirigé par Ling, la seule biologiste marine de la ville, et Surya y mène ses recherches. Ouvert du dimanche au vendredi, fermé le samedi.
description_en: The Laboratory is located in Starlet Town and is currently run by the town's only marine biologist, Ling. It is also the place where Surya conducts his research. The town’s laboratory is open Sunday-Friday and is closed on Saturdays.

description: Le Lac abrite sans doute le lieu le plus magique de Coral Island. Traversez le pont de bois pour découvrir le temple ancien, considéré comme la source de l'eau et de la terre fertile de l'île.
description_en: The Lake guards perhaps the most magical place in Coral Island. Find your way through the wooden bridge and discover the ancient temple. It’s believed to be the main source of water and where the island's rich soil originates from.

description: Le chalet d'Emma, où elle vit avec sa compagne Dippa.
description_en: Emma’s Cottage is the cottage where Emma lives with her partner, Dippa.

description: La maison de Zoe, Mark, Anne, Paul et Bonbon.
description_en: The house where Zoe, Mark, Anne, Paul, and Bonbon lives.

description: Le Belvédère se trouve à l'ouest de la plage et au sud de la ferme, à la pointe sud de l'île. Le phare s'y dresse.
description_en: The Lookout point is located west of the Beach and south of the Farm, at the southernmost point of Coral Island. It is home to the Lighthouse.

description: Le Manoir victorien est la demeure de Ling, Leah et Randy. Centenaire, c'est l'un des trois bâtiments d'origine de Coral Island.
description_en: Victorian Mansion is a landmark which is the home to Ling, Leah, and Randy. It is a 100-year-old building, and one of the three original buildings in Coral Island.

description: La maison du maire, où vit Connor.
description_en: Mayor’s house is the place where Mayor Connor lives.

description: Le magasin général des ondins se trouve dans le Royaume des ondins. C'est aussi la maison de Todi et Lawu.
description_en: Merfolk General Store is a location in Merfolk Kingdom. It is also Todi and Lawu's house.

description: Le Royaume des ondins abrite les ondins au large de Coral Island. Il est gouverné par le roi Krakatoa et la reine Nanda Devi depuis le Palais des Nagas. Il existe de nombreux villages d'ondins dans le monde.
description_en: The Merfolk Kingdom is where the merfolk off the coast of Coral Island live. The kingdom is ruled by King Krakatoa and Queen Nanda Devi from Naga Palace. There are many merfolk villages around the world, and some characters allude to being from other merfolk places.

description: La Forêt intermédiaire est une zone au sud de la forêt.
description_en: Mid Forest is an area in the southern side of the Forest.

description: Maison partagée par Millie et Yuri.
description_en: House shared by Millie and Yuri.

description: Mme Ramen est un restaurant de ramen tenu par Emma, au-dessus de Prise et Poêle au centre-ville. On peut y acheter des plats cuisinés.
description_en: Mrs. Ramen is a ramen shop run by Emma above Socket and Pan in the town center. The shop offers cooked meals for sale.

description: Le Musée, à gauche du Centre communautaire, est le lieu de travail de Scott. On peut y donner artefacts, gemmes, créatures marines, insectes, poissons, etc., qui y sont exposés. Il ouvre le 3e jour du printemps de la première année.
description_en: The Museum is located to the left of the Community Center and is also the place where Scott works. The player can donate artifacts, gems, critters, insects, fish and more here. Donations are put on display here. The Museum opens on the third day of Spring of the first year, entering for the first time will trigger .

Krakatoa
Miranjani
Maharaja Put Put
Nagalita
Naga

description: L'Observatoire se trouve au nord de Hillside Brewery and Vineyard. Chaem (à gauche) et Wakuu (à droite) y vivent ; le week-end, Wakuu loge chez son père Wataru. Ouvert tous les jours de 9 h à 21 h.
description_en: Observatory is one of the buildings in Startlet Town. It is located north of the Hillside Brewery and Vineyard. Chaem and Wakuu live here. Chaem's bedroom is located on the left side of the building. Wakuu's bedroom is located on the right side of the building. On the weekends Wakkuu will stay with his dad, Wataru. The Observatory is open everyday from 9 am to 9 pm.

description: L'océan entoure Coral Island. Il abrite coraux, poissons et autres espèces marines, ainsi qu'un royaume d'ondins dont on parle et que le joueur peut découvrir en pêchant ou en plongeant.
description_en: The ocean is the large body of water in which Coral Island is situated. It is home to a wide variety of corals, fish, and other sea life, as well as the rumored location of a merfolk kingdom, that the player may come across while fishing or diving.

extra.situe: Autour de Coral Island, accès depuis le ponton de plongée

description: La Chambre de l'Oracle se trouve dans le Royaume des ondins ; elle est tenue par l'Oracle du royaume, Cho Oyu.
description_en: The Oracle Chamber is located in Merfolk Kingdom and is currently run by the Oracle of the Kingdom, Cho Oyu.

description: Le refuge pour animaux, au Centre communautaire, permet d'adopter un animal de compagnie.
description_en: Pet shelter is a shop in the Community Center where the player can adopt a pet.

description: Un phare vide avec un escalier en colimaçon menant au sommet.
description_en: An empty lighthouse with spiral stairs to access the top.

description: Prise et Poêle est une boutique entre le Labo et le Magasin de meubles, tenue par Luke. On y achète les ustensiles de cuisine une fois la maison agrandie avec une cuisine.
description_en: Socket & Pan is a shop located between the Laboratory and the Furniture Store. Luke owns and operates the store. The player can buy utensils required for cooking here once the house has been upgraded to include a kitchen.

description: Pufferfish Drilling Corporation est une compagnie de plateformes pétrolières qui vient d'ouvrir un bureau régional à Starlet Town, représenté par Karen.
description_en: Pufferfish Drilling Corporation is an oil rig company who recently opened its regional office in Starlet Town. The Coral Island region of Pufferfish is represented by Karen.

description: La Boutique Pufferfish est accessible depuis l'ordinateur robuste.
description_en: Pufferfish Shop is a store accessible through the Sturdy computer.

description: Le Bois de Purwo n'est accessible que pendant le Festival de plantation d'arbres.
description_en: Purwo Woods is a location that is only accessible through the Tree Planting Festival.

extra.situe: La zone de déclenchement se trouve au-dessus de la ferme : y entrer donne accès au Bois de Purwo.

description: Le Café de Raja est un petit café en plein air tenu par Raj, devant Fishensips sur les quais. On y vend desserts et boissons.
description_en: Raja's Coffee Corner is a small outdoor coffee shop run by Raj in front of the Fishensips in town docks. The shop offers cooked desserts and beverages for sale.

description: Le Ranch, au pied de la forêt, est tenu par Jack et Kenny. Il est souvent sans personne la nuit.
description_en: The Ranch is located near the foot of the forest and it is run by Jack and Kenny. The Ranch is often unattended at night.

description: Le Marché flottant de Ratih est tenu par la marchande itinérante Ratih. Il s'installe devant le Café de Raja, sur les quais, les mardi, jeudi et vendredi matin. On y trouve des produits artisanaux et des graines. Absent en hiver.
description_en: Ratih's Float Market is a shop owned and operated by visiting merchant Ratih. The shop is located right in front of the Raja's Coffee Corner on docks on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday mornings. The shop sells various artisan products and seeds. It does not appear during Winter.

description: Le Centre de loisirs se trouve sur l'ancien terrain de Pufferfish Drilling Corp, en face du cimetière.
description_en: Recreation center is located on the old Pufferfish Drilling Corp lot, across from the town cemetery.

description: Le Centre de recyclage est un gachapon qui permet d'obtenir des objets exclusifs en échange de déchets. Au début du jeu, c'est un petit endroit où ramasser des déchets à la faux ; depuis la 1.1, l'attraction « Junior Upcycler » le rend pleinement fonctionnel.
description_en: Recycling Center is a gachapon trove that offers players the chance to obtain exclusive items in exchange for trash. At the beginning of the game, the Recycling center serve as a small place where player can scythe for trash. After version 1.1 release, the player can unlock the attraction Junior Upcycler to have a fully functional recycling center.

nom_fr_alias: Stand de la charrette de vente
description: Le stand de la charrette de vente est une boutique du Royaume des ondins tenue par Vihren.
description_en: Sales Cart Stall is a shop in Merfolk Kingdom run by Vihren.

description: Le salon de coiffure, à côté de la Clinique, finit par partager son bâtiment avec White Flamingo. Tenu par Emily et Erika, il est ouvert du mardi au vendredi de 9 h à 17 h et le dimanche de 12 h à 17 h ; fermé lundi et samedi.
description_en: Hair Salon sits next to the Clinic and eventually shares a building with White Flamingo. It is run by both Emily and Erika. The shop is open Tuesday-Friday 9am-5pm, Sunday 12pm-5pm, and closes on Mondays and Saturdays.

description: La Savane est un biome unique et mystérieux au nord de Starlet Town, connu pour ses animaux et ses étranges plantes-champignons. On y entre par une rafflésie géante qui téléporte le joueur. Il y fait toujours beau.
description_en: Savannah is a unique and mysterious biome north of Starlet Town. It is known for its distinctive animals and peculiar mushroom plants . Players can enter through a giant rafflesia flower, which teleports them into the Savannah. Unlike the rest of Coral Island, the Savannah’s weather stays sunny all the time.

description: Le Ranch de la savane, au sud-est de la Savane, est tenu par Dame Lavanna.
description_en: The Savannah ranch is located in the southeastern area of the Savannah and it is run by Lady Lavanna.

stock.description: Autruche adulte. Vit au poulailler. Pond des œufs d'autruche quand on en prend bien soin.
Buffle adulte. Vit à l'étable. Produit du lait de bufflonne quand on en prend bien soin.

description: Starlet Town est l'un des principaux lieux de Coral Island. De nombreux habitants y vivent et ses commerces couvrent tous les besoins. La ferme du joueur est à quelques pas.
description_en: Starlet Town is one of the primary locations of Coral Island, set on the titular Coral Island. Many townsfolk live in and around town, and the available amenities fill all the basic needs. The player's farm is a short walk away.

description: Le Taco Truck d'Emma est installé près de l'École élémentaire Starlet. Emma cuisine des ingrédients locaux trouvés en forêt ou achetés aux fermiers.
description_en: Emma’s Taco Truck is a food establishment located near Starlet Elementary School. It is owned and run by Emma. Emma uses local ingredients that she finds around the forest and purchases goods from local farmers.

description: Le Temple du lac est un temple mystérieux présent sur l'île depuis longtemps, au bord du lac, au nord-est.
description_en: The Lake Temple is a mysterious temple that has been on the island for a while. The player can find it at the lake in the northeastern part of the island.

description: The Floating Boat is Theo’s personal boat that he uses to fish. A hand-me-down from his dad, Jim, his vintage boat isn't the shiniest on deck-- though somewhat fully functional.
description_en: The Floating Boat is Theo’s personal boat that he uses to fish. A hand-me-down from his dad, Jim, his vintage boat isn't the shiniest on deck-- though somewhat fully functional.

description: The Red Boat is a broken boat decked on the pier next to Theo’s Floating Boat. It seems that the boat can be tweaked though.
description_en: The Red Boat is a broken boat decked on the pier next to Theo’s Floating Boat. It seems that the boat can be tweaked though.

description: Tidal Threads est une boutique de vêtements du Royaume des ondins tenue par Lanin.
description_en: Tidal Threads is a clothing store in Merfolk Kingdom owned by Lanin.

description: La poubelle des touristes sert de boîte à dons ou de poubelle aux touristes de passage à Starlet Town.
description_en: The Tourist bin serves as a donation box or trash can for tourists who have visited Starlet Town.

description: Des poubelles sont réparties sur toute l'île, près de la plupart des bâtiments. On peut y fouiller sans dépenser d'énergie (clic droit) une fois par jour. On y trouve surtout des déchets, mais parfois du poisson ou des produits de cueillette.
description_en: Trash cans are located all over Coral Island next to most buildings. The player can rummage through them at no energy cost by right clicking on them to get an item once per day. The most common item obtained from trash cans is trash; however, the player can also get more valuable items like fish or forageables.

description: Les Bulles au trésor sont des arbres-gachapon qui permettent d'obtenir des objets exclusifs en échange de récoltes. Il y en a deux dans la Savane, à l'est et à l'ouest.
description_en: Treasure Bubbles are gachapon trees that offers players the chance to obtain exclusive items in exchange for crops. There are two in the Savannah to the east and the west.

extra.situe: Est et ouest de la Savane

description: La ferme sous-marine, au sud-est du Royaume des ondins, permet de vivre, de cultiver des cultures océaniques et d'élever des animaux sous-marins.
description_en: The underwater farm is where players can live, grow ocean crops, and tend underwater farm animals. The underwater farm is located southeast of Merfolk Kingdom.

description: Le Ranch sous-marin, à l'ouest du Royaume des ondins, est tenu par Slamet. Il est accessible une fois la Bénédiction des ondins reçue.
description_en: The Underwater Ranch is located on the west side of Merfolk Kingdom and it is run by Slamet. The shop is available once the player receives the Merfolk Blessing.

description: La Villa abandonnée appartenait à d'anciens habitants de Coral Island partis brusquement il y a des années, sans que personne ne sache pourquoi. Leur fille unique, aujourd'hui vingtenaire, y revient chaque été. Elle est amie avec Lily et avec les jumelles de l'Auberge du corail.
description_en: The Abandoned Villa is a villa owned by former residents of Coral Island. Nobody really knows why the family left, but they left abruptly many years ago. Their only daughter, now in her 20s, still visits the villa in the summer. She is a good friend with Lily as well as the twins who run the Coral Inn.

description: White Flamingo est la boutique de vêtements d'Antonio à Starlet Town. D'abord une tente près du manoir de Ling, elle devient une vraie boutique au rang de ville E.
description_en: White Flamingo is the clothing store in Starlet Town owned by Antonio. It begins as a tent next to Ling's Mansion and opens as a full-sized store when the player reaches town rank E.

description: Les Bois s'étendent à l'ouest du Lac et au nord de Starlet Town. On y trouve l'école, le Taco Truck d'Emma et les maisons d'habitants qui préfèrent le calme de la nature. Plus à l'ouest, la Colline mène à la Forêt sauvage.
description_en: The Woodlands of Coral Island are situated west of the Lake and north of Starlet Town. This area includes the school, Emma's Taco Truck, and the houses of multiple islanders who prefer the quiet of nature and nearby river over living in the town. Head further west to see the Hillside on the way to the untamed trees of the Forest.

description: Le bateau de Zarah est amarré à la jetée du centre-ville. Elle y vit seule, cuisine ou se détend ; pour voir du monde, elle reste sur la jetée devant son bateau ou croise les passants en forêt.
description_en: Zarah’s Boat is docked on the pier in the town center. She lives alone and usually cooks or sits around relaxing when she is at home. When she is socializing, she can be found on the pier in front of her boat or with passersby in the forest.
